testimonials.t1Text: My experience with Dr. AlHasan was exceptional. The results exceeded my expectations by far, and the care from the entire team was outstanding. I highly recommend him to anyone considering a cosmetic procedure.
testimonials.t2Text: After years of consideration, I finally decided on a rhinoplasty procedure. Dr. AlHasan made the entire experience comfortable and easy, and the results look completely natural. No one could tell!
testimonials.t3Text: The professionalism and attention to detail at Dr. AlHasan's practice is unmatched. I feel youthful again and my confidence has been fully restored.

faq.title: Frequently
faq.subtitle: Answers to the most commonly asked questions about our procedures and services.
faq.q1: How do I know which procedure is right for me?
faq.a1: We offer a comprehensive free consultation where Dr. AlHasan evaluates your needs and explains all available options. Every treatment plan is personalized for each patient.
faq.q2: How long is the recovery period?
faq.a2: Recovery duration varies by procedure. Generally, most patients return to normal activities within 1-2 weeks. We provide detailed post-procedure care instructions.
faq.a3: Absolutely. We specialize in achieving natural results that enhance your features without altering your appearance. Our goal is to bring out the best version of you.
faq.a4: Safety is our top priority. We use the latest internationally certified equipment and techniques. Dr. AlHasan holds certifications from the world's most prestigious medical societies.
faq.a5: We accept various payment methods and offer flexible payment plans. All financial details can be discussed during your initial consultation.
faq.q6: Can I see results similar to my case?
faq.a6: Absolutely! We have a comprehensive gallery of before-and-after photos for a wide range of procedures. Dr. AlHasan can also show results similar to your specific case during the consultation.
